pages.title: Loan default and restructuring

pages.title: Online purchase refund dispute
pages.primaryIntent: Was the order cancelled, undelivered, returned or different from its description?
pages.decisionGuidance: Identify the seller, order terms, payment and reason for the refund request. Compare delivery or return evidence with the seller's response and any platform process. A seller refund and a payment dispute are separate routes; avoid making inconsistent claims or seeking duplicate recovery.
evidenceChecklist: order and product description, payment receipt, delivery or return proof, refund request and seller or platform responses

pages.title: Defective product and consumer claim
pages.primaryIntent: What defect appeared and what remedy was requested from the seller?
pages.decisionGuidance: Document the product, purchase date, defect, normal use and seller's response. Preserve photographs and any inspection or repair history. Repair, replacement, refund and injury claims require different evidence; if the product appears unsafe, stop using it and seek appropriate assistance.
evidenceChecklist: receipt and warranty, product description, defect photographs, inspection or repair records and seller correspondence

pages.title: E-commerce platform account dispute
pages.primaryIntent: Is the platform withholding access, listings or seller funds?
pages.decisionGuidance: Identify the platform decision, cited policy and affected account functions or funds. Preserve the applicable terms, transaction ledger and appeal history. Separate identity verification, alleged policy breaches and payment holds so the response addresses the actual reason given.
evidenceChecklist: platform notice and terms, account ownership records, affected listings or transactions, held-funds ledger and appeal responses
